text:
zoe_finance: Heads up — noticed ~30 invoices in today's batch with line amounts that have the wrong sign (credits where charges should be) and a subset of invoices had the PDF generated twice. attaching a tiny sample below :facepalm:

zoe_finance: ```csv
invoice_id,customer,sku,amount_cents
inv_20260301_001,acme,compute, -10000
inv_20260301_001,acme,discount, - -10000  # appears as duplicate negative
inv_20260301_045,betacorp,compute, -20000  # should be 20000
```

devon_billing: ugh. do we know if this is a rendering/pdf step or earlier in the pipeline? :eyes:

zoe_finance: looks like the DB rows have negative amounts for usage lines. PDFs then show the same values. I spotted that the reserved discount lines are fine. It's mainly ad-hoc usage and some quota adjustments.

alina_eng: I deployed billing-service v2.8.1 at 02:12 with a migration that changed line_amount_cents -> signed_int (to support refunds). The migration included a naive cast: `ALTER TABLE invoice_lines ALTER COLUMN amount_cents TYPE integer USING amount_cents * -1 WHERE amount_cents < 0;` That was a dumb conditional I forgot to remove. Investigating now.

matt_ops: stripe-bot shows a flurry of re-send events between 02:15-02:18 for same invoice IDs — maybe retry logic caused duplicate PDFs. I'll pause the PDF generator queue and block re-sends to Stripe for a minute.

stripe-bot: webhook delivered: invoice.sent inv_20260301_001 to accounting@acme.com (delivery_id=wh_789)

devon_billing: good call. matt, please do a small audit: list invoice IDs created between 02:00-03:00 where sum(line.amount_cents) < 0 or where pdf_count > 1. send as CSV to #finance-private when you have it.

matt_ops: running quick query now, should have results in ~10m.

alina_eng: confirmed — migration logic had a leftover WHERE clause from a test. rolling back the migration and scheduling a correct one. will open a PR with revert and a non-destructive patch.

zoe_finance: thanks. two asks: 1) can we hold manual sends/collections for impacted invoices until we fix and re-issue? 2) need a list of affected customers to flag CS and Sales. rachel, FYI for customer comms.

rachel_sales: got it. please send list and I'll draft a short note. prioritize Enterprise accounts first.

devon_billing: creating an incident ticket and tagging Legal for any contract risk. also will not auto-retry failed payments for those invoices.

matt_ops: audit CSV ready: 31 invoice IDs, attached in #finance-private. (I deduped by invoice_id and pdf_checksum).

alina_eng: deploy rollback completed at 02:54. current plan: 1) run a corrective script to flip signs for rows that were inverted (with safe preview) 2) re-generate PDFs 3) push corrected invoices to customers and Stripe with a note. I'll post the SQL preview here before running.

zoe_finance: please include a checksum of original rows and confirm idempotency. we need an undo plan if anything else goes wrong.

alina_eng: absolutely. preview: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, line_id, amount_cents, -amount_cents as corrected FROM invoice_lines WHERE migrated_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01 02:10' AND '2026-03-01 02:20' AND amount_cents < 0;```

devon_billing: thanks. I'll hold sends and coordinate with CS. ticket #BILL-3427.

zoe_finance: tl;dr: root cause = accidental migration transform, impact = ~31 invoices with negative charge lines and ~12 PDFs duplicated, mitigation = rollback + corrective script + withheld sends. will reconvene after fix and re-issue plan. :thumbsup:
